learner_operation: Identify the entire signed constant multiplying ln(x), rewrite ln(x)/d as (1/d)ln(x), and apply the constant-multiple rule to produce c/x.

fixed_features.feature: Single ln(x), x>0, derivative with respect to x
fixed_features.justification: Tutorial and canonical example teach this derivative; changing arguments or adding terms introduces other knowledge points.

fixed_features.feature: One correct answer in a five-option radio bank or an equivalent-expression blank
fixed_features.justification: Captured response contracts. The count constrains the response format, not which option qualifies.

fixed_features.feature: Modest reduced nonzero constants and distinct choices
fixed_features.justification: Preserves easy workload. Denominator 1 collapses quotient distractors; numerator 1 collides in the original fraction bank but is now reachable in quotient and blank families.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Signed integers, fractions, unit fractions and multiples of e
answer_roles.observed: Six profiles present; both quotient signs and distinct denominators survive delivery.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Small denominators with a valid five-option bank
answer_roles.observed: Independent boundaries 2,4,12 and controlled 4->5; author regression independently rerun across all 2..12 with both signs.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Any option position; irrelevant to differentiation
answer_roles.observed: Varied serialized and actual UI positions, separately measured.

delivery.result: 5/5 actual batch records and 38/43 independent samples survive. All six sampled profiles survive. Batch has five distinct derivatives and three quotient records with both signs and denominators 5,8,9; no tested cue answers all of it. Captured pool has nine keyed, nonretired ordinary records. Positive easy weight selects uniformly within the fresh easy band; unconfigured policy chooses lowest ID. No live draws claimed.
